gaps.text: In-line measurement of Process temperature with temperature sensor

Combining several spectroscopy methods (data fusion) (Low-level fusion: synchronized MIR-ATR and Raman spectra from the same probe spot merged into one matrix with block scaling. Both channels must sample the same material and be normalized to a common time step. The fused model must beat the best single method on held-out batches, otherwise the extra instrument is dropped.)
Achievable fiber link length for a mid-IR (CIR/PIR) connection between the process point and an analyzer outside the process area.
The analyzer can sit outside the process area connected by fibers for the chosen method.
